thread:
Aisha: Quick check  we need a micro social plan for the analyst cohort webinar. Deliverables: X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn single post + carousel, 10s clip for stories, and one stat card for the website hero. Routing: tag leads `cohort-webinar-may` and send to `sdr-webinar-rotation`. Who owns what? @Ben?

Ben: I can handle the stat card + hero image. Send me the final numbers and any legal copy for the footer.

Maya: Numbers are in the shared one-pager: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/may_cohort. Topline: 57% latency drop, 2.0x throughput, 28% cost reduction. Legal: add "sample workloads; results may vary" small text.

Ben: Got it. Will produce PNG/SVG + 1200x628 hero. ETA Wed 11am PT.

Aisha: Copy guidance: X thread starts with a bold stat, then quick method note, then CTA. LinkedIn should be story-driven for PMs. Also want two caption tones: (1) confident, (2) measured-technical. Maya can you draft both?

Maya: Yes. I'll drop both variations in this thread by Tue EOD. Short X hooks <140 chars. LinkedIn long-form ~3 short paragraphs.

Rui: Routing questions: do we want a unique UTM per format so we can attribute `x_thread` vs `li_carousel`?

Aisha: Yes. Use `utm_campaign=cohort_may&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic` and set `utm_content` to `x_thread`, `li_carousel`, `story_clip` respectively. Also ensure form prefill param `ref=cohort_may` for better SDR context.

Rui: I'll add the rule in staging and run a test. Will also set auto-assign to `sdr_webinar_rotation`.

Anna-bot: Reminder: Optimal organic slots found: Mon/Tue 10:00 AM PT and Wed 09:00 AM PT. Scheduling available in Console.

Ben: One creative note: for the hero card can we show a tiny timeline graphic of the test? Makes the stat feel more tangible. Will mock option A/B.

Aisha: Love it. Make A/B and we'll pick one. Also prepare alt text for accessibility.

Maya: Draft captions uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/copy/cohort_may_captions.md. Variation A (confident) and B (measured) included.

Rui: Staging test passed at 14:12 PT  sample lead with tag `cohort-webinar-may` routed to `sdr-webinar-rotation-staging` and UTM params intact.

Ben: Uploaded assets v1 (hero + stat card + A/B timeline) at 15:05 PT. Will export story clip 10s now.

Aisha: Proposed schedule: Mon 10:00 PT  X lead stat + clip (variant A); Tue 10:00 PT  LinkedIn carousel + long copy (variant B); Wed 09:00 PT  X reminder + register CTA. If 24h CTR < 1% flip CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin hero.

Maya: I'll prepare fallback CTAs and pin text. Also prepping short alt captions for paid boost if we promote.

Rui: Will run prod smoke test after first publish and confirm in thread.

Anna-bot: Scheduling job queued for Mon 10:00 PT.

Aisha: Thanks all. Final runbook before schedule: Ben finalize hero by Wed 11am, Maya finalize copy Tue EOD, Rui validate routing prod post-publish, Aisha will schedule and tag UTMs. Ping here when done.

Ben: Noted  finalizing now.

Maya: Draft B updated with the PM quote.

Rui: Prod smoke test OK after publish at 10:07 PT  lead landed in `sdr-webinar-rotation` with `utm_content=x_thread`.

Aisha: Closing thread  good job team :rocket:
